pages.quiz:
CREATIVE ARTS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #18
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: CREATIVE ARTS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which of these four-beat patterns ends on a long note? (1 mark)
   A. ta-te taa ta-te taa
   B. taa taa taa (rest)
   C. taa ta-te taa (rest)
   D. ta-te ta-te ta-te ta-te

2. Which is a safety rule for sprint races? (1 mark)
   A. Run in any lane
   B. Run backwards
   C. Never push or trip another runner
   D. Push to get ahead

3. Why keep a recorder away from strong sun and fire? (1 mark)
   A. The sun makes it sing
   B. Heat can bend it
   C. It becomes lighter
   D. It becomes invisible

4. Of the notes B, A and G, which is the lowest? (1 mark)
   A. A
   B. B
   C. G
   D. They are equal

5. Uncovering holes makes the note (1 mark)
   A. the same
   B. lower
   C. silent
   D. higher

6. The line on which letters sit is called the (1 mark)
   A. descender line
   B. baseline
   C. ascender line
   D. border

7. The Kodaly hand sign for r is (1 mark)
   A. a sloping palm
   B. a closed fist
   C. a flat hand held level
   D. a wave

8. In a crab balance, your body should look like (1 mark)
   A. a ball
   B. a snake
   C. a table
   D. a spear

9. On the Kenyan flag, red stands for (1 mark)
   A. peace
   B. the blood shed in the struggle for freedom
   C. the land
   D. the sky

10. Why should you take turns to talk about each other's work? (1 mark)
   A. It is fair and respectful
   B. So no one speaks
   C. To make others sad
   D. To waste time

11. To compose a rhythm means to (1 mark)
   A. play an instrument only
   B. copy a friend's pattern exactly
   C. erase a pattern
   D. create a new pattern

12. What is the danger of pointing a camera directly at the sun? (1 mark)
   A. It makes the picture sharper
   B. It makes the sun cooler
   C. It saves the battery
   D. It can hurt your eyes and spoil the picture

13. The crab walk is done (1 mark)
   A. standing tall
   B. face down on the tummy
   C. on hands and feet with the tummy facing up
   D. lying still

14. Colour value means (1 mark)
   A. how loud a colour is
   B. how light or dark a colour is
   C. the smell of paint
   D. the price of a colour

15. When accompanying singers, the drummers should (1 mark)
   A. shout the words
   B. stop at every line
   C. play as loud as possible
   D. play softly enough for the singers to be heard

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. Explain how you would learn a simple melody on B, A and G. (4 marks)

17. What is the centre of interest in a photograph? (3 marks)

18. Describe the correct posture and hand position for playing the recorder. (4 marks)

19. State four safety rules for gymnastics. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
CREATIVE ARTS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #18 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. A — ta-te taa ta-te taa
   Only the first ends on a crotchet (taa).

2. C — Never push or trip another runner
   Pushing or tripping can hurt people.

3. B — Heat can bend it
   Heat can warp or crack the instrument.

4. C — G
   More holes covered gives a lower note.

5. D — higher
   Shorter air column means a higher note.

6. B — baseline
   All letters sit on the baseline.

7. A — a sloping palm
   Ray is a palm that slopes upward.

8. C — a table
   Arms and legs are the table legs, and the body is the top.

9. B — the blood shed in the struggle for freedom
   Red stands for the blood shed for freedom.

10. A — It is fair and respectful
   Taking turns shows respect and love for others.

11. D — create a new pattern
   Composing is creating something original.

12. D — It can hurt your eyes and spoil the picture
   Looking at the sun harms the eyes.

13. C — on hands and feet with the tummy facing up
   It is like the crab balance, but moving.

14. B — how light or dark a colour is
   Value is the lightness or darkness of a colour.

15. D — play softly enough for the singers to be heard
   Accompaniment supports the singers and must not cover their voices.

SECTION B
----
16. (4 marks)
   Answer: Sing it in sol-fa, clap and say the rhythm, finger the notes without blowing, play slowly, then speed up keeping the beat steady.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each step.

17. (3 marks)
   Answer: The main subject that you want the viewer to notice first, for example a friend's face or a flower.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for main subject, 1 mark for noticed first, 1 mark for an example.

18. (4 marks)
   Answer: Sit or stand tall. Hold the recorder pointing down and away. The left hand is at the top and the right hand at the bottom. The left thumb covers the thumb hole and fingers cover holes with the pads.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

19. (4 marks)
   Answer: Use a mat or soft ground; keep the space clear; remove jewellery; tie back long hair; warm up; take turns; stop if there is pain. Any four.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each rule.
